digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, prose guides, criteria registry
propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids inline without automated coupling to the authoritative criteria registry, allowing criterion text to change silently while guide claims about it remain unchanged and become stale

A citation pin manifest derived from criterion digests enables the gate to detect when a cited criterion's text changes, forcing visible re-verification and re-pinning rather than silent semantic drift

The pin gate must extract citations using vocabulary-only matching against the closed criterion-id set at word boundaries, independent of guide markup or structure, so ordinary prose edits do not break validation

The pin gate validates four classes of problems: unknown citations (absent ids), stale pins (changed criterion text), orphan pins (unpinned citations), and missing manifests, reporting each to guide authors with the remedy
